title: Publicly described ChatGPT export message tree
method: Independent secondary documentation and open-source parser references, separated from the v0002 saved-page code. No user's export has been opened or collected.
privacy: Public field names and original summaries only. No example chat messages, real conversation identifiers, account fields, export files or raw API response content.

official.claim: OpenAI documents conversation JSON files as a component of ChatGPT data exports; large exports may be divided across numbered JSON files.
official.source_title: OpenAI Help Center — transferring exported conversations
official.limits: The Help Center documentation cited here does not specify a stable message-node graph schema.

community.claim: Community-maintained export tooling describes mapping-based trees and an active current_node, including 2026 export archives.
Public parser models describe mapping of message nodes, parent/children references, and current_node.
Community notes distinguish older mapping trees from newer flat messages responses in a private endpoint. Those endpoint responses are not equivalent to data exports.

export_tree_fields.meaning: Map of node keys to exported message-node records.
Reference from a node to its parent or null.
List of possible child node references, including alternatives.
Selected node reference used to derive an active path by following parents.

derived_operations.description: Follow current_node to ancestors, then reverse; do not render all mapping nodes as one chronological list.
Multiple children under a node can indicate alternate continuations in export trees.
Nodes outside the selected ancestry path may still exist in the export tree.

limitations: These are externally documented/exported-data semantics, not observed runtime state or verified v0002 JavaScript handler behavior.
Some private endpoint response formats have changed; do not silently translate flat messages arrays into tree structures.
Export structure is not proof that the backend stores conversations in the same form.
No customer, user, or account export was examined; local analyzer tests use invented node trees only.
